dedupe_keys.name: draf local multi energy demand response tool

description: draf is a Python analysis framework for local multi-energy hubs and demand response. The project publishes component templates for batteries, electric vehicles, heat pumps, boilers, photovoltaics, wind, hydrogen and industrial production processes, alongside demand-analysis tools. Users provide load and generation time series, technology settings, tariffs and operational constraints. Mixed-integer or linear optimisation produces schedules, capacity choices and plots for the configured hub and study period. Its geographic scale is a building, campus or local hub, with temporal detail following input series. MIT-licensed source runs on Windows, macOS and Linux. A limitation is that component templates and prices are abstractions; a result needs local equipment and contract checks before operational use. draf supports flexible electricity and heat-infrastructure planning. The catalogue's model-pypsa is a separate general grid modelling tool, not a draf dependency. No demonstration scenario was executed.
name: draf local multi-energy demand-response tool
